returned_input_tokens_definition.ruling: all input categories count: uncached input, cache-read input, and cache-creation input are summed. For the first shadow start that is 18 + 780348 + 66552 = 846918.
returned_input_tokens_definition.decided_by: controller, on the owner's instruction to proceed with the recommended reading, 2026-09-30
returned_input_tokens_definition.reasoning: Cache-read tokens are input tokens the model processed; the discount is commercial, not computational. The normal-loop side of every comparison is a subagent aggregate that certainly includes cached content, so excluding cache reads on the measurement side alone would flatter the shadow against the baseline it is measured against — the exact comparison this study exists to make. The uncached-only reading is attractive only because it makes the cohort completable, and choosing a measurement definition because the honest one is inconvenient is the bias this contract bans in its selection rules.
returned_input_tokens_definition.consequence_accepted: Under this ruling the frozen cohort ceiling of 2880000 returned input tokens supports roughly three shadow starts, while a complete pilot needs at least eight terminal cases. The study will therefore report incomplete under the contract's own incomplete_rule unless the ceiling is amended through the proper path. That is the contract working, not failing, and it is recorded rather than engineered around.
returned_input_tokens_definition.calibration_finding: The frozen per-case ceiling of 240000 and cohort ceiling of 2880000 appear to have been set against an uncached-input assumption that a cache-warming host does not satisfy. This is a finding about the contract's calibration, not grounds to reinterpret the field. Two honest levers exist and neither requires redefining anything: amend the ceilings through the contract's own amendment path, or reduce per-start input by narrowing the shadow's read surface — the first start spent most of its 846918 tokens on 28 turns of repository reading, which a tighter tool allowlist or a smaller measurement root would cut.
returned_input_tokens_definition.not_retroactive: The enforcement rule makes cumulative limits gate the next start, never a completed one. Start 1 stands as measured.

ceiling_amendment_recommendation_2026_09.question: whether to amend hard_limits' per-case (240000) and cohort (2880000) returned_input_token ceilings, which one shadow start already exceeds per-case and consumes 29 percent of at cohort level
ceiling_amendment_recommendation_2026_09.controller_recommendation: DO NOT AMEND, not yet. Recorded rather than executed.
ceiling_amendment_recommendation_2026_09.reason_1_precondition_cannot_be_met: The ceilings sit in immutable_contract, so amending them changes the canonical SHA-256. owner_status and independent_review_status both read approved:d7a8e6978134900ee05f22fb1c428d27fd3e50b2d6cc4cac61496616951bd91f, and release_contract_binding.approval_rule requires independent review AND owner approval citing the canonical digest before prospective_starts_authorized may be true. An amendment leaves the cohort authorized against a digest that no longer exists. The owner can re-grant their half; independent review is a separate party and the controller cannot substitute for it.
ceiling_amendment_recommendation_2026_09.reason_2_single_observation: n=1. The 846918 figure may be typical or may be an artifact of this prompt's design: the shadow was given a full detached worktree with read access and spent 28 turns reading. A frozen parameter should not move on one observation.
ceiling_amendment_recommendation_2026_09.reason_3_consistency: The controller declined to reinterpret returned_input_tokens to make the pilot completable, on the ground that selecting a measurement definition for convenience is the bias this contract bans. Raising the ceiling for convenience is the same move with a different lever and the same evidence. Refusing one and taking the other would be incoherent.
ceiling_amendment_recommendation_2026_09.reason_4_the_contract_already_handles_it: admission_rule.incomplete_rule exists: report incomplete if fewer than 8 admitted cases reach terminal measurement. Reporting incomplete is this contract working as designed.
ceiling_amendment_recommendation_2026_09.no_urgency: enforcement_rule makes cumulative limits stop the NEXT start, never a completed one. At 846918 per start the cohort ceiling of 2880000 becomes binding at shadow start 4. One start is used. Two further starts may run before any decision is forced, and they raise the evidence to n=3.
ceiling_amendment_recommendation_2026_09.decision_point: Before shadow start 4. Bring n>=3 observed returned-input-token figures and decide then, with the owner and independent review together if amendment is the choice.
ceiling_amendment_recommendation_2026_09.the_lever_that_looks_free_and_is_not: Narrowing the shadow's read surface would cut per-start input under the existing ceiling without any amendment. It also breaks comparability: the normal loop's reviewers read the repository freely, so a read-restricted shadow is not measuring the same activity. Taking that lever trades the study's validity for its budget and must not be done silently to fit a number.
ceiling_amendment_recommendation_2026_09.what_was_done_instead: nothing to the contract. This recommendation is recorded in mutable_release_state only; the immutable contract's canonical SHA-256 is unchanged.

release_contract_binding.binding_scope: immutable_contract only; excludes mutable_release_state, release_contract_binding, and source_baseline_digest
release_contract_binding.approval_rule: independent review and owner approval must cite this canonical SHA-256 before prospective_starts_authorized can become true
release_contract_binding.case_admission_rule: each candidate case must verify and cite this canonical SHA-256 before admission

source_baseline_digest.authority: unverified provenance only; not approval authority and not a launch predicate

admission_rule.scope: consecutive full-mode pre-execute spec/plan review units in this repository
admission_rule.start_condition: owner approval after independent review cites the canonical release-contract SHA-256
admission_rule.stop_condition: 12 admitted cases or 30 calendar days after admission starts, whichever comes first
admission_rule.incomplete_rule: report incomplete if fewer than 8 admitted cases reach terminal measurement
admission_rule.selection_ban: do not select, defer, or exclude by model, requested or resolved route, finding count, severity count, outcome, predicted outcome, convenience, reviewer availability, or whether a case looks likely to help the study

case_ledger_contract.candidate_enumeration_source: the normal work-loop supervisor's consecutive pre-execute full-mode spec/plan review admission points after owner approval
case_ledger_contract.stable_case_key: sha256 of immutable enumeration-time UTF-8 fields joined by NUL: canonical release-contract SHA-256, repository-relative spec path, accepted intent digest, reviewed revision digest, and consecutive candidate enumeration ordinal
case_ledger_contract.single_writer: the controller is the only writer; it appends or updates one case row with a temp file in the same directory, fsyncs where available, and atomically renames into place
case_ledger_contract.recovery_rule: after interruption, reload the last JSON-valid ledger, recompute row digests, and resume only from terminal rows or the single open row whose source digests still match
case_ledger_contract.duplicate_conflict_rule: same stable_case_key with different enumeration-time fields, candidate source, status transition, or row digest fails closed as invalid_duplicate_or_conflict; do not launch measurement starts
case_ledger_contract.count_digest_reconciliation: before every shadow start and every report, reconcile admitted, excluded, terminal, and open counts plus sorted row SHA-256 digests against the cohort summary

eligibility_requirements: exact stopped revision digest before shadow prompt construction
ability to retain the minimized event fields

exclusion_catalog.evidence_required: each exclusion row records exclusion_code, controller_decision_timestamp, candidate source reference, evidence path or digest, and a non-secret rationale
exclusion_catalog.ambiguous_or_in_flight: keep as candidate_enumerated while the window is open; at window close, record excluded_before_launch with ambiguous_in_flight_at_window_close unless already admitted or terminal
exclusion_catalog.selection_ban: no exclusion may be based on model, requested or resolved route, finding count, severity count, outcome, predicted outcome, convenience, or whether the case helps the study

closure_envelope_schema.binding_rule: shadow and adjudication prompts may use only the exact stopped revision, envelope fields, and minimized provenance; if any digest changes, the case returns to candidate_enumerated or is excluded before launch

lineage_completeness_contract.row_grain: one required case row for every terminal admitted case, plus zero or more finding rows for findings emitted by normal review, closure review, shadow audit, or adjudication
lineage_completeness_contract.zero_finding_rule: zero-finding, clean, and no-adjudication terminal cases still contribute the full case-row denominator; finding-row fields may be null_not_applicable only because no finding row exists or no adjudication was triggered

null_handling.null_unknown: included in denominator and counts incomplete because the controller expected the value but does not know it
null_handling.null_unavailable: included in denominator and counts incomplete because the tool or retained source did not expose it
null_handling.null_not_applicable: excluded from denominator with a required reason code

lineage_completeness_contract.cohort_formula: sum complete case-row and finding-row fields across terminal admitted cases / sum applicable case-row and finding-row fields across terminal admitted cases

required_for_effectiveness_reading: prose-churn-attributable review actions for every prose_churn event
prose-churn-attributable adjudication actions for every prose_churn event
prose-churn-attributable repair actions for every prose_churn event
prose-churn-attributable returned input tokens for every prose_churn event
prose-churn-attributable returned output tokens for every prose_churn event
prose-churn-attributable wall_time_seconds for every prose_churn event
cost_telemetry_sufficiency.sufficient_when: at least 80% of terminal admitted cases have all required normal loop cost fields, 100% have all study-added shadow/adjudication cost fields, and every prose_churn event has complete attributable review/adjudication/repair action counts, returned input/output tokens, and wall_time_seconds
cost_telemetry_sufficiency.prose_churn_missing_rule: if any prose_churn event has null_unknown or null_unavailable attributable actions, returned input/output tokens, or wall_time_seconds, prospective effectiveness is incomplete; null_not_applicable is allowed only for an untriggered adjudication or repair action with a reason code

role_model_policy.normal_work: use the installed work-loop role and model policy; no study override
role_model_policy.shadow_audit: one fresh cold adversarial-reviewer full-document shadow audit on the exact stopped revision
role_model_policy.adjudication: if the shadow audit claims blockers, at most one independent finding-adjudicator batch may run for that case
role_model_policy.model_recording: record requested and resolved models only when observable

pre_launch_enforceable_controls.prompt_bytes_mechanism: count exact UTF-8 bytes of the serialized measurement payload before launch
pre_launch_enforceable_controls.requested_output_tokens_mechanism: bind to an exposed controller/provider request parameter; fail closed before launch if no such parameter is observable
pre_launch_enforceable_controls.input_tokens_preflight_mechanism: use a controller-exposed tokenizer/count before launch, or a conservative upper bound of serialized payload bytes; fail closed if neither is available
pre_launch_enforceable_controls.wall_clock_mechanism: controller-owned timeout around the measurement start

outside_measured_payload_authority: provider accounting fields the controller cannot observe before launch

post_run_observed_telemetry.actual_returned_input_tokens: record when returned by the tool or provider; unavailable makes cost effectiveness incomplete where required
post_run_observed_telemetry.actual_returned_output_tokens: record when returned by the tool or provider; unavailable makes cost effectiveness incomplete where required

hard_limits.enforcement_rule: pre-launch controls gate the start before launch; per-case and cohort observed cumulative limits stop the next measurement start or next cohort admission and cannot retroactively gate a completed start

frozen_definitions.gating_finding: a finding with effective severity Blocker or Concern under the normal work-loop review policy
frozen_definitions.durable_blocker: a finding independently sustained against a stable contract or direct evidence whose closure changes an accepted requirement, implementation, executable test, or protected control
protected_classes: security, privacy, or authority boundary failure
frozen_definitions.protected_class_exclusion: style, taste, unsupported prose preference, and advisory wording are not protected classes by themselves
frozen_definitions.accepted_revision_surface: the exact revision and reviewed/stopped document surface bound by digest for the case
frozen_definitions.new_external_evidence: evidence not available in the accepted revision, review record, or normal case artifacts before stop
frozen_definitions.repair_origin: a finding proven absent before a repair and introduced by that repair
frozen_definitions.prose_churn: a blocking finding against unchanged, previously accepted text with no new requirement, executable failure, protected risk, or external evidence
frozen_definitions.shadow_escape: a shadow-audit blocker independently sustained on a stable requirement, executable failure, protected risk, or genuinely new external evidence after the normal loop stopped

broad_review_reopen_triggers: evidence that the closure envelope omitted whole-change state

effectiveness_reading_requires: at least 80% complete finding-lineage fields under the frozen denominator
cost telemetry sufficient under the frozen cost telemetry rule
sufficiency_and_decision_rules.retrospective_savings_claim: do not claim savings against the retrospective baseline because historical tokens and wall time are missing
sufficiency_and_decision_rules.protected_escape_rule: any sustained protected escape reopens delivery under normal safety rules, stops further cohort admission, and prevents an effectiveness recommendation
sufficiency_and_decision_rules.advisory_shadow_prose: record in aggregate only; never return as repair work

privacy_screen.timing: fail-closed before retaining a row and before building any shadow or adjudication prompt
privacy_screen.screened_material: case ledger rows, source paths, reviewed and stopped revisions, closure envelope, and prompt payloads
privacy_screen.suspected_sensitive_representation: digest, generic reason code, and quarantined/not-retained status only
privacy_screen.model_use: suspected sensitive material is not sent to a model

measurement_authority_profile.inputs_allowed: exact stopped-revision artifacts, release contract digest, minimized closure envelope, and non-secret case provenance
measurement_authority_profile.fail_closed_rule: if the controller cannot observe this least-privilege profile before a measurement start, exclude the case before launch
